correctionPass.trigger: SHELFCHECK — LANGUAGE BARRIER PASS #2 CORRECTION: Josh/ChatGPT review requested re-verification of ids 2763, 2779, and 2376 specifically.
changes: id 2763 Warui Ousama to Rippana Yuusha: CUT_CANDIDATE -> KEEP_ENGLISH. Confirmed same playable identity as NIS America's 'The Cruel King and the Great Hero' (developed by Nippon Ichi Software, same director/premise), which received a genuine North American/English physical PS4 release (NISA, March 11 2022, Standard + Storybook Edition, English text with Japanese audio). The prior pass correctly found no SEPARATE 'Cruel King' ShelfCheck identity exists, but incorrectly treated that as meaning the identity has no English option — it does not need a second identity: this identity's own underlying game already has a confirmed English physical PS4 product. No identity reconciliation/merge is actually needed since only one ShelfCheck identity exists for this game; it should simply be classified KEEP_ENGLISH.

id 2779 Zero: Tsukihami no Kamen: CUT_CANDIDATE -> KEEP_ENGLISH. The prior pass only checked the Japan-only physical disc (PLJM-17164). Re-investigation surfaced a separate Asia-region physical PS4 release, catalog number PLAS-11373 (UPC 4710782158986), explicitly marketed by multiple independent retailers (Play-Asia, TokyoGameStory, eBay listings titled '(Asian ENGLISH)', Amazon listing titled '(Multi-Language)') as a Multi-Language release with an English cover. This is corroborated by Sony's own Asia-region PS Store digital listing for the same game/build ('FATAL FRAME: Mask of the Lunar Eclipse (PS4 & PS5)', Indonesia/Malaysia stores) explicitly stating supported languages as 'Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese'. This PLAS-11373 disc is region-free and satisfies the same playable identity as 'Zero: Tsukihami no Kamen'. English appears to be part of the base multi-language build (not a deluxe-only or patch-only feature) based on the base digital listing carrying the same language tag; no patch requirement was found. Per the task rule that any qualifying physical PS4 product satisfying the identity in English keeps it INCLUDED, this identity should be KEEP_ENGLISH, not cut merely because the Japan-only SKU lacks English.

id 2376 Dokyusei: Bangin' Summer CSver: UNCERTAIN -> CUT_CANDIDATE. Deeper research (not merely inferring from the later Western digital release) found: (1) a Japan-market boutique product page for the actual CSver catalog number (CDJapan, PLJM-17345) describing it plainly as 'the Japan version' with no English mentioned anywhere; (2) independent research confirming the PS4 CSver's language is Japanese only, explicitly stating it does NOT support Chinese or English text options; (3) confirmation that the only English-supporting release ('Home Edition', Simplified Chinese/English/Traditional Chinese) is a separate, later (2025), West-targeted digital PS Store product, with no evidence it is the same disc build as the 2024 Japan CSver physical release. Since the physical CSver disc itself is not shown to carry English, and the only confirmed-English version is a distinct digital product not established as sharing that localization, this now clears the bar for CUT_CANDIDATE rather than remaining UNCERTAIN.

id 2763 (Warui Ousama to Rippana Yuusha) is KEEP_ENGLISH as of the correction pass: it is the same playable game as NIS America's English physical PS4 release 'The Cruel King and the Great Hero' (March 2022). id 2410 (Wonderland TOD-Reloaded) was reclassified to KEEP_ENGLISH after this pass's own re-verification overturned an earlier (incorrect) cover-pass note that had called it 'unrelated' to NIS America's English 'Touhou Genso Wanderer Reloaded' (PS4, CUSA11862, physical, 2018). Direct evidence (the game's own Steam listing showing 'Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded- / 不思議の幻想郷TOD -RELOADED-' as the same product across regions) confirms they are the same release. This is flagged explicitly because it corrects prior research from an earlier task, exactly the kind of case the task instructed to re-verify rather than trust inherited assumptions.
